title: 第3章 开三腔
content_zh:
第3章 开三腔
殡仪馆。
灵车将尸体拉到，一溜烟的就跑了，留下一具重甸甸的尸体摆在手推车上。
“做法医，就要从搬尸体开始。”吴军背着手，脸上绷不住的挂着笑容，道：“你这个身板，真适合搬尸体。”
他那些在大城市的同学，早二十年就过上了搬尸自由的生活了，宁台县却是个留不住人的地方，新招考的法医来了又走了，走了又来，一年到头，他也混不到几次有人搬尸体的生活。运气最糟糕的时候，是新法医在的时候没尸体，走了以后，才有尸体进来。
江远推着车，好奇的问道：“县局没有解剖室吗？就那种光打起来发白的……”
“像电视剧里那种？”吴军摇摇头，道：“有钱的城市能弄得起，咱们这样的小县城就不要想了。咱们搞尸检，不单单要解剖室，还需要冰棺之类的设备存放尸体吧，稍微讲究点，这些换气设备，洗浴间，都得维护管理。不如租殡仪馆的，县局再出个十几万，几十万的，把解剖室弄弄好，就行了。”
“取证之类的会不方便吧。”
“一般就是抽点血，弄点胃容物，就这么大的县城，远能远到哪里去，好停车更重要。”吴军说着一笑，道：“反正尸体都不挑的。”
江远低头看看自己十七叔，心道，十七叔过年的时候来家里，似乎是有些挑剔的。当然，现在估计是没兴趣耍性格了。
“你以后再过来的时候，记着兜里揣包烟，偶尔买点糕点之类的，搞搞关系。跟殡仪馆的人处好了，做事也方便。”吴军走在旁边，摁了电梯，低声教了江远一句：“殡仪馆也是职场。”
江远笑了笑，说：“好。”
宁台县殡仪馆将解剖室设在了地下室。
好在有电梯上下，还算是方便，只是幽暗走廊里闪烁的红色消防灯有点渗人。
房间内倒是光线充足，大瓷砖的地面，小瓷砖的墙面，正中是一张不锈钢的解尸台，进门左手边则是一个盥洗池，以及长长一排的不锈钢柜体，不仔细看，还以为是普通人家的厨房装修。
这时候，吴军上前帮忙，将手推车推到了解尸台旁，用脚踩着，将手推车的台面升高，与解尸台并起，再将尸体缓缓的倒到解尸台上，方道“你去看看家属来了没有，来了的话，就喊人过来，解剖了。”
江远应了一声，眼睛直勾勾的看向十七叔。
膘肥体壮的十七叔，如今仰躺在不锈钢台面上，肚皮高高隆起，白白的亮着，在灯光的照耀下，还能看到竖起来的细毛，一时间让江远有些瘆得慌，更多的，则是不适的心慌。
“电话在门边。”吴军淡淡的提醒了江远一声，没多说话。
江远挪开了眼神，走到门边，拿起固定电话，打了出去。

在国内，尸体解剖是需要通知近亲到场并签字的，而在具体实践中，来的往往是姐夫、姑父或者女婿这样的非血缘亲属，偶尔来的是直系亲属的，通常需要多准备一个垃圾桶。
不一会儿，有人被领了进来，茫然且畏惧的看着周围的一切。
“姑父。”江远认出了人，算起来，他是十七叔的妹夫，也就是他十九姑的老公，两人应当在前两年祭宗祠的时候见过面。
“江远啊！”姑父见到江远，却是分外的亲切，用饱含情绪的目光，隔着大舅哥的尸体，望着江远：“你十七叔走的急，还好你是验尸官，给他做漂亮些……”
“我们开始了。”吴军打断两人聊天，给江远塞了一套全身式的手术服，让他套在衣服外面，再一把掀掉了尸体上的白布，问：“确认一下，是江建成本人吧？”
姑父干呕了一声，才道：“应该是。”
“签个字。身份证号也写上。”吴军看着家属落笔，再收好文件，然后看向江远，问：“不是每个人都敢给认识的人做尸检的，你要是不愿意做，也正常。”
“我可以。”江远进来前，就已经做过心理建设了。现在的他，内心有各种情绪的混杂，但并不想简单的一退了之。
吴军再确认一次，点头道：“你先来。”
他也想看看江远的能力，如果江远做不下去了，或者出纰漏了，他也好给他上上课。前面来的那些个新人法医，吴军都是这么教育过来的。
江远的表情严肃，略显紧张和迟疑。
对于尸检，江远本身的经验是不多，但在学校里的少数几次实践，他的表现都得到了教授的赞赏，被称做“极有天赋”。
如果今次不是十七叔的尸体，他或许会更镇定一些。
“首先检查尸表。”江远深吸一口浊气，皱眉一闪即逝，接着沉浸下来，将一个笔记本放在旁边，边看尸体，边道：“死者江建峰，50岁，性别男，身长169，体重188……左臀处有月牙型胎记，长约5厘米……”
“然后是一般状态记录。直肠尸温是……”江远闷头做事，一路记下头皮的情况，秃顶的情况，直到瞳孔、结膜、鼻腔、牙齿……
尸表检查的大部分都是在现场就完成了，江远只是按部就班的念了前面的部分，到了结膜牙齿等部分，则是再次仔细检查了一遍。
这种做法，令吴军颇为满意，点头道：“做的可以……做过解剖没？”
江远道：“在学校做过几例。”
“那不错。现在好多学校，学生都只能做一例了。”
“我是跟着教授做项目的时候，参与了几次解剖。”

“哦，开过三腔吗？”吴军说的三腔是颅腔、胸腔和腹腔，它们包裹着人体重要的内脏血管和神经，是法医病理学做死因判断的重要途径。
江远应“是”，且道：“我开过两次。”
“那你来开。”吴军将手术刀端给江远，又道：“你可能知道，但我还是提醒一句，切的时候要注意，别切到自己的手。解剖室的温度太低了，刀片又快，刚切到的时候，你自己都感觉不到。判断标准就是有没有鲜血流出来，尸体是不流血的，所以流血的只可能是你……”
江远点头，再看看面前的尸体，调整了一下姿势，就拿起手术刀，放低刀刃，抵住颈部，一条直线，一直划到耻骨联合的上方……
十七叔的身体厚重，需要切的很深，翻出来的脂肪也是又黄又白。
超长的一字型切口，超长超大，远比影视作品中的尸检看着要残酷。这种也是国内法医常用的术式，与美国的Y字型切口略有不同。
紧接着，江远开始分离胸部的肌肉组织，接着再沿着肋骨和胸骨相连的软骨分界线走刀。
尸检才开始进行，精神紧张的姑父深吸了一口气，继而脸色一变，转身就吐了起来。
(本章完)

Chapter 3 Opening three chambers
Funeral Home.
The hearse pulled the body and ran away quickly, leaving a heavy body on the trolley.
"For forensic medicine, we have to start by moving corpses." Wu Jun put his hands behind his back and said with an unbearable smile on his face: "Your body is really suitable for moving corpses."
His classmates in big cities had already lived a life of freedom in moving corpses twenty years ago, but Ningtai County was a place that couldn't keep people. The newly recruited forensic doctors came and went, and came and went. Throughout the year, he could not get through the life of someone moving corpses a few times. The worst luck comes when there is no body when the new medical examiner is here, and only after he leaves does the body come in.
Jiang Yuan pushed the cart and asked curiously: "Doesn't the county bureau have an autopsy room? The kind that turns white when exposed to light..."
"Like the one in the TV series?" Wu Jun shook his head and said, "Rich cities can afford it, so don't even think about it in a small county like ours. When we do autopsies, we not only need an autopsy room, but also equipment such as ice coffins to store the corpses. To be more careful, these ventilation equipment and bathrooms must be maintained and managed. It is better to rent a funeral parlor, and the county bureau will provide hundreds of thousands or hundreds of thousands to complete the autopsy room."
"It will be inconvenient to collect evidence and so on."
"Usually just draw some blood and get some stomach contents. In such a big county, you can go as far as you want, and parking is more important." Wu Jun said with a smile and said: "We don't pick the corpses anyway."
Jiang Yuan looked down at his Seventeenth Uncle and thought to himself that Seventeenth Uncle seemed a bit picky when he came to the house during the Chinese New Year. Of course, I probably have no interest in showing off my personality now.
"When you come here again, remember to carry a pack of cigarettes in your pocket, buy some cakes and the like occasionally, and build relationships. If you get along with the people at the funeral home, it will be easier to do things." Wu Jun walked beside him, pressed the elevator, and whispered to Jiang Yuan: "Funeral homes are also a workplace."
Jiang Yuan smiled and said, "Okay."
Ningtai County Funeral Home has its autopsy room in the basement.
Fortunately, there is an elevator to get up and down, which is quite convenient, but the flashing red fire lights in the dark corridor are a bit intrusive.
There is plenty of light in the room, with large tiles on the floor and small tiles on the walls. There is a stainless steel autopsy table in the middle, a wash basin on the left hand side of the door, and a long row of stainless steel cabinets. If you don't look carefully, you might think it is a kitchen decoration for ordinary people.
At this time, Wu Jun stepped forward to help, pushed the trolley to the autopsy table, stepped on it with his feet, raised the top of the trolley, and leveled it with the autopsy table, and then slowly poured the body onto the autopsy table. Fang said, "Go and see if the family members are here. If they are, call someone over and do the autopsy."
Jiang Yuan responded, looking straight at Uncle Seventeen.
Uncle Seventeen, who was fat and strong, was now lying on his back on the stainless steel table. His belly was bulging high and white. Under the light, you could still see the fine hairs standing up. For a moment, Jiang Yuan was a little scared and panicked. More importantly, he felt uncomfortable and flustered.
"The phone is by the door." Wu Jun reminded Jiang Yuan lightly without saying much.
Jiang Yuan looked away, walked to the door, picked up the landline phone, and called out.
In China, autopsies require close relatives to be notified and signed. However, in actual practice, those who come are often non-blood relatives such as brothers-in-law, uncles, or sons-in-law. Occasionally, those who come are direct relatives. Usually, an extra trash can needs to be prepared.
After a while, someone was brought in, looking at everything around them in confusion and fear.
"Uncle." Jiang Yuan recognized the person. Calculating, he was the brother-in-law of his seventeenth uncle, who was also the husband of his nineteenth aunt. The two should have met during the ancestral ceremony two years ago.
"Jiang Yuan!" When my uncle saw Jiang Yuan, he was extremely kind. He looked at Jiang Yuan across the body of his uncle with emotion-filled eyes: "Your seventeenth uncle left in a hurry. Fortunately, you are doing the autopsy."Officer, make him look more beautiful..."
"Here we go. Wu Jun interrupted the chat between the two, stuffed Jiang Yuan with a full-body surgical gown and asked him to put it on outside his clothes. He then took off the white cloth on the body and asked, "Can you confirm, is it Jiang Jiancheng himself?" "
My uncle retched before saying, "It should be. "
"Sign. Also write down your ID number. Wu Jun watched the family members write down, then put away the documents, then looked at Jiang Yuan and asked, "Not everyone dares to do an autopsy on someone they know. If you don't want to do it, that's normal." "
"I can. "Jiang Yuan had already done some psychological construction before he came in. Now, he has a mixture of emotions in his heart, but he doesn't want to simply retreat.
Wu Jun confirmed again, nodded and said: "You come first. "
He also wanted to see Jiang Yuan's ability. If Jiang Yuan couldn't do it anymore or made mistakes, he could give him lessons. The new forensic doctors who came before were all educated in this way by Wu Jun.
Jiang Yuan's expression was serious, slightly nervous and hesitant.
Jiang Yuan himself did not have much experience in autopsy, but in the few practices in school, his performance was praised by the professor and he was called "extremely talented".
If it wasn't Uncle Seventeen's corpse this time, he might be calmer.
“First check the corpse form. "Jiang Yuan took a deep breath, his frown disappeared for a moment, then he became immersed, put a notebook next to him, looked at the body, and said: "The deceased, Jiang Jianfeng, was 50 years old, male, 169cm long, 18cm heavy... There was a crescent-shaped birthmark on the left hip, about 5cm long..."
“Then there’s the general state record. The rectal body temperature is..." Jiang Yuan was busy working, writing down the condition of his scalp, baldness, pupils, conjunctiva, nasal cavity, teeth...
Most of the body surface examination was completed on site. Jiang Yuan just read the previous parts step by step. When it came to the conjunctiva, teeth and other parts, he carefully inspected them again.
This approach made Wu Jun quite satisfied, and he nodded and said: "It's OK...Have you done any dissection?" "
Jiang Yuandao: “I have done several cases in school. "
"That's good. In many schools now, students can only do one example. "
“When I was working on a project with a professor, I participated in several dissections. "
"Oh, have you ever opened three chambers? "The three cavities Wu Jun mentioned are the cranial cavity, the thoracic cavity and the abdominal cavity. They wrap the important visceral blood vessels and nerves of the human body and are an important way for forensic pathology to determine the cause of death.
Jiang Yuan answered "yes" and said, "I've done it twice. "
"Then you drive. Wu Jun handed the scalpel to Jiang Yuan and said: "You may know, but I still remind you, be careful not to cut your own hand when cutting." The temperature in the dissecting room is so low and the blade is so fast that you don’t even feel it when you first cut it. The criterion is whether there is blood flowing out. The corpse does not bleed, so the only one who bleeds is you..."
Jiang Yuan nodded, looked at the corpse in front of him again, adjusted his posture, picked up the scalpel, lowered the blade, held it against the neck, and drew a straight line to the top of the pubic symphysis...
Uncle Seventeen's body is thick and needs to be cut very deeply, and the fat that comes out is yellow and white.
The extremely long straight incision is extremely long and extremely large, and looks far more cruel than the autopsies in movies and TV shows. This technique is also commonly used by domestic forensic doctors, and is slightly different from the Y-shaped incision in the United States.
Immediately afterwards, Jiang Yuan began to separate the muscle tissue of the chest, and then moved the knife along the cartilage dividing line connecting the ribs and sternum.
The autopsy had just begun. The nervous uncle took a deep breath, then his expression changed, he turned around and vomited.
(End of chapter)
